title: Why both Haas drivers are getting Monza aero upgrades – but only Ollie Bearman has a new PU

title: What Alpine got right at Monza and everyone else got wrong
paragraphs: The car that's currently sixth in the Formula 1 constructors' championship just took pole position in a straight fight in a dry qualifying session at the Italian Grand Prix. F1 is used to freak underdog poles in mixed weather, but Pierre Gasly and Alpine's Monza achievement was something very different.
